name: The Story Spine
axiom: Five clauses turn a status update into a story with a cause and a consequence.
trigger: Sixty-second pitches and investor teasers, where the whole story must fit in one breath.

steps.text: Once upon a time: the world as it was.
Every day: the routine that held it there.
One day: the disruption that changed the routine.
Because of that: the consequences, chained.
Until finally: where the chain arrives.

antiPattern.violation: Filling the clauses with product features, so 'because of that' has no causal force and the spine collapses into a list.
antiPattern.remediation: Each clause must be caused by the one before. If you can reorder them, it is not a spine.

prompt: Once upon a time, ______. Every day, ______. One day, ______. Because of that, ______. Until finally, ______.
